title: Slim the /sdlc skill to run+report+HITL — PLAN RE-RUN (cq-2): PR C re-scoped to the exit-code EX_AUTH_FATAL-mirror chain (#3447 JobSupervisor now in event_loop/), PR B done + 2 carry-forward follow-ups, PR D unchanged
summary: Operator kicked the pipeline back to plan to act on resolved cq-2 (opt-3: pause PR C, re-plan). This artifact SUPERSEDES the prior architect analysis for PR C only. CORRECTION (cq-2, coder implement finding): the previous PR C mechanism — 'sniff throttling wording (429/rate-limit/overloaded) at the all-producers streak-exhaustion site in concurrent_executor.py' — is INVALID. Only a per-agent EXIT CODE crosses the pod boundary: handle_agent_failure sees f'Container exited with code {N}' and the exhaustion report's exit_detail is just 'exit_code=N' (kubernetes_spawner/_models.py exit_detail_for); the agent's error TEXT is never observable orchestrator-side. The ONLY faithful mechanism is a DISTINCT EXIT CODE mirroring the EX_AUTH_FATAL chain (#3373), and — because #3447 relocated JobSupervisor out of concurrent_executor.py into orchestrator/event_loop/ — the classification must be intercepted at the per-arm RECORDING layer in event_loop/_supervisor.py so it never feeds the fail-streak halt. New PR C file chain (~7 files): shared/egg_agent/auth_errors.py (add EX_RATE_LIMITED=<new code> + is_transient_rate_limit_error(text), reusing the throttling vocabulary the file already documents as excluded from EX_AUTH_FATAL) -> shared/egg_agent/__main__.py (return EX_RATE_LIMITED when is_transient_rate_limit_error matches, alongside the existing EX_AUTH_FATAL return at :143) -> orchestrator/kubernetes_spawner/_models.py (JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED + outcome_for/exit_detail_for mapping of the new exit code, mirroring the EX_AUTH_FATAL==77 detection at :100) -> orchestrator/event_loop/__init__.py (JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED constant beside JOB_OUTCOME_FATAL at :147) -> orchestrator/event_loop/_loop.py (_observe_jobs branch at ~:86-116 dispatching JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED -> supervisor.record_rate_limited, beside the JOB_OUTCOME_FATAL->record_fatal branch at :94-101) -> orchestrator/event_loop/_supervisor.py (record_rate_limited: a paced, NO-streak-halt sibling of record_fatal at :205 — it must NOT latch _alerted_10/_exhausted or increment the abort streak; instead it records a rate-limit-paced state) -> orchestrator/supervision_policy.py (pacing window + loop-guard fingerprint constants; hours-scale, not the 30s SUPERVISION_BACKOFF_CAP_SECONDS) -> orchestrator/concurrent_executor.py (windowed retry driver, deterministic-loop guard, cq-1 threshold OVERSEER_ALERT, and landed-slice-preserving restart_phase-equivalent wiring). All PR C acceptance criteria (AC-C1..C7) and the binding cq-1 resolution (no hard wall-clock ceiling; OVERSEER_ALERT once cumulative wait crosses a threshold) are UNCHANGED — only the mechanism and file set are corrected. PR B (slice-1) is COMPLETE (task-1-1/1-3 @ 4fcf1ed7a, task-1-2 @ c2a77847a, task-1-4 @ 3593d497c) and MUST NOT be re-derived, but two post-consensus review findings must be carried forward as explicit PR B follow-up tasks: (a) WIRE the slice_closed_emitter at the production SliceScheduler construction site orchestrator/routes/pipelines/_run_implement.py:86 (currently default-None, so slice.closed never fires in production — green-but-dead); (b) add an INTEGRATION test driving the real record_complete/record_failure -> event bus -> _STATUS_WAIT_EVENT_TYPES allowlist chain (not a hand-published event). PR D (slice-3) is UNCHANGED: coverage-map gate first, then host-detector deletions preserving the render-on-alert flows, then remove overseer_owns_host_detection entirely.

problem_statement.description: Plan re-run driven by resolved contract decision cq-2 (opt-3). During implement the coder discovered PR C's contracted mechanism cannot work: AC-C1 requires the throttling signature to classify as transient rate-limit (NOT abnormal, NOT tripping the per-key fail-streak halt), but the throttle wording the plan assumed was 'observable at the streak site' never crosses the pod boundary — only a numeric exit code does. The fix is an EX_AUTH_FATAL-style distinct exit code plumbed through the (post-#3447) event_loop supervision chain, intercepted at the recording layer so the transient class bypasses the streak halt. PR B already shipped but has two known post-consensus gaps (unwired production emitter + missing end-to-end emission test) that must not be lost. PR D is unaffected.

pr_c_corrected_exit_code_chain.why_the_old_mechanism_fails: handle_agent_failure receives only f'Container exited with code {N}'; the exhaustion report's exit_detail_for returns 'exit_code=N' (kubernetes_spawner/_models.py:102-131). The agent error TEXT (429 / 'rate limit' / 'overloaded') is NOT present orchestrator-side, so 'classify by wording at the streak site' is unimplementable. Classification MUST ride a distinct exit code set inside the agent process, exactly like EX_AUTH_FATAL.
shared/egg_agent/auth_errors.py: EX_AUTH_FATAL=77 (:40); is_auth_fatal_error(text) (:83). ADD: EX_RATE_LIMITED = <distinct code, e.g. 78> and is_transient_rate_limit_error(text) matching the throttling signatures this module already documents as excluded from fatal (429 / 'rate limit' / 'overloaded', :24-28/:45-47). Do NOT widen EX_AUTH_FATAL / _AUTH_FATAL_PATTERNS; reuse the throttling vocabulary rather than duplicating regexes.
shared/egg_agent/__main__.py: Imports EX_AUTH_FATAL, is_auth_fatal_error (:15); returns EX_AUTH_FATAL (:143); sys.exit(main()) (:149). ADD: import + return EX_RATE_LIMITED when is_transient_rate_limit_error matches (checked before/beside the fatal branch so a genuine weekly-cap fatal still wins its own match).
JobStatusView maps container exit codes to outcomes: outcome_for (:44), _FATAL detection via exit_code==EX_AUTH_FATAL (:100), exit_detail_for (:102-131). ADD: detect exit_code==EX_RATE_LIMITED -> JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED (a sibling of the EX_AUTH_FATAL->_FATAL mapping).
orchestrator/event_loop/_loop.py: _observe_jobs (:54) reads outcome_for (:75) and dispatches: SUCCESS->record_success (:86), LEGITIMATE->record_legitimate_outcome (:90), FATAL->record_fatal (:94-101), ABNORMAL->record_abort (:116). ADD: a JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED branch -> supervisor.record_rate_limited(key, action, role, exit_detail=...). This is the interception point that keeps the transient class OFF the abnormal/streak path.
orchestrator/event_loop/_supervisor.py: JobSupervisor (relocated here by #3447). record_fatal (:205) exhausts on first occurrence and LATCHES the streak alerts (_alerted_warn/_alerted_10=True, adds to _exhausted). ADD: record_rate_limited — a PACED sibling that MUST NOT do any of that: no _exhausted, no _alerted_10 latch, no abort-streak increment; instead record a rate-limit-paced state (reset-time-paced when the exit_detail/error carries it, else bounded backoff) and hand the windowed-retry driver enough to re-arm. This is the concrete realization of AC-C1 ('not abnormal / does not trip the fail-streak halt').
orchestrator/supervision_policy.py: SUPERVISION_BACKOFF_FACTOR=2 (:18), SUPERVISION_BACKOFF_CAP_SECONDS=30 (:19); streak anomaly agent-invocation-fail-streak (:25-26). ADD: hours-scale pacing-window constants for the rate-limit path (distinct from the 30s cap) and the loop-guard fingerprint definition (signature + phase/slice progression).
orchestrator/concurrent_executor.py: Windowed-retry driver, deterministic-loop guard, cq-1 threshold OVERSEER_ALERT emission, and the landed-slice-preserving restart_phase-equivalent wiring. Note: the plan's old 'JobSupervisor integration (concurrent_executor.py)' anchor predates #3447 — JobSupervisor itself now lives in event_loop/; concurrent_executor.py is the retry/loop-guard/alert orchestration layer, not the recording layer.
pr_c_corrected_exit_code_chain.unchanged_invariants: AC-C1..C7 and cq-1 stand exactly. cq-1: NO hard wall-clock ceiling (retry until the cap lifts, reset-time-paced when present else bounded backoff) BUT emit an OVERSEER_ALERT once cumulative wait crosses a threshold. The threshold alert (attended-operator visibility) and the deterministic-loop-guard escalation (identical-fingerprint reproduction) are ORTHOGONAL triggers — neither is a time-ceiling halt. EX_AUTH_FATAL (incl. matched weekly/usage caps) and ordinary abnormal failures behave UNCHANGED — the new path fires ONLY on the EX_RATE_LIMITED exit code.

findings.finding: PR C's only faithful classification carrier is a distinct process exit code (EX_RATE_LIMITED), not error-text sniffing. The orchestrator sees exit codes, never agent stderr text (kubernetes_spawner/_models.py exit_detail_for returns 'exit_code=N'). This is the load-bearing correction from cq-2.

The transient class MUST be intercepted at the per-arm RECORDING layer (event_loop/_supervisor.py record_rate_limited), NOT at the retry-driver layer, to satisfy AC-C1 ('does not trip the fail-streak halt'). record_fatal (:205) is the structural model but the rate-limit variant must NOT latch _alerted_10/_exhausted or increment the streak — otherwise per-producer AGENT_FAILED HITLs fire first and AC-C1 is only partially met (exactly the failure mode of cq-2 opt-2, which the operator rejected).

#3447 relocated JobSupervisor from concurrent_executor.py into orchestrator/event_loop/_supervisor.py. The old plan anchor is stale. Post-#3447 division of labor: event_loop/_supervisor.py = recording/classification (record_*), concurrent_executor.py = retry/loop-guard/alert orchestration. PR C touches BOTH plus the agent-side (auth_errors.py, __main__.py) and the outcome-mapping (kubernetes_spawner/_models.py, event_loop/__init__.py) — ~7 files, up from the contracted 3. This is faithful expansion, not scope creep (cq-2 opt-1 was the operator's adopted direction via opt-3 re-plan).

cq-1 binding is unchanged and must ride the corrected mechanism: no hard ceiling; reset-time-paced retry when the error carries a reset hint else bounded backoff; threshold OVERSEER_ALERT once cumulative wait crosses the threshold; loop-guard escalation on identical fingerprint. The threshold alert and loop-guard escalation stay orthogonal — do not collapse them into a time-ceiling halt.
